instruction: Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Create a module that splits a 16-bit input word into two 8-bit outputs using a 256-to-1 demultiplexer and a multiplexer. However, the new module should have a different control logic that enables either the demultiplexer or the multiplexer based on an odd/even parity check of the input word. The output should be the active module's value.
